build_cpp_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and iterate over nodes with Generate
parse_cpp_identifiers: parse all identifiers from a C++ file using PrintIndentifiers with a predicate filter
parse_multiple_cpp_files: parse identifiers from multiple C++ files using PrintAllIndentifiers with a predicate filter
convert_tokens_to_parameters: convert a list of C++ tokens into Parameter AST nodes using TypeConverter.ToParameters
convert_tokens_to_types: convert a list of C++ tokens into Type AST nodes using TypeConverter.ToType for base classes
